title: Loz's music discs
description: Mod that adds new music disks to the game.
body:
Mod adds new music disks that you can craft from disc shards in stone cutter.

Some of them are:
- Barbie song
- BHop theme
- Consequences of pride
- Hang'Em all
- Here comes the sun

And more.

Some disks have 2 variants, 1 that plays normaly, and 2 that plays in whole world.
